posts.author: Mellow Moon
posts.text: I made a to-do list. Then I took a nap to recover from making it.
posts.translation: やることリストを作った。その疲れを癒すために昼寝した。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: Lists are exhausting. I respect your recovery plan.
replies.translation: リスト作りは疲れるよね。その回復計画、尊敬する。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: Did you put "take a nap" on the list?
replies.translation: 「昼寝する」ってリストに入れた？

posts.author: Lost in My 20s
posts.text: Does anyone else feel behind in life, even when nothing is actually wrong?
posts.translation: 特に問題はないのに、人生で出遅れてる気がする人っている？

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: Life isn't a race. Your pace is still a pace.
replies.translation: 人生は競争じゃない。自分のペースも立派なペースだよ。

replies.author: Tiny Dragon
replies.text: I still can't fold a fitted sheet. We're all learning.
replies.translation: 私なんかボックスシーツも畳めない。みんな学んでる途中さ。

posts.author: Office Ghost
posts.text: This meeting could have been an email. That email could have been a nap.
posts.translation: この会議はメールで済んだはず。そのメールだって昼寝で済んだはず。

replies.author: Night Owl
replies.text: Finally, a management strategy I understand.
replies.translation: やっと理解できる経営戦略が出てきた。

posts.author: Tiny Dragon
posts.text: I cleaned one corner of my room and now I need a medal.
posts.translation: 部屋の隅をひとつ掃除した。もうメダルが欲しい。

replies.author: Mellow Moon
replies.text: Here you go: 🏅
replies.translation: はいどうぞ、メダルだよ。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: Please clean my corner next.
replies.translation: 次は私の部屋の隅もお願い。

posts.author: Wise Owl
posts.text: You don't have to be good at something to enjoy doing it.
posts.translation: 得意じゃなくても、楽しんでいいんだよ。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: I needed this after today's practice.
replies.translation: 今日の練習のあとに聞きたかった言葉だよ。

posts.author: Monday Survivor
posts.text: I woke up early to be productive. I spent 40 minutes choosing a playlist.
posts.translation: 生産的に過ごすため早起きした。プレイリスト選びに40分使った。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: The playlist is part of the process.
replies.translation: プレイリスト選びも大事な工程だよ。

posts.author: Lost in My 20s
posts.text: How do you make friends as an adult without saying, "We should hang out," forever?
posts.translation: 大人になってから友達を作るにはどうしたらいい？「今度遊ぼう」だけで永遠に終わらずに。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: Try suggesting a specific day and place.
replies.translation: 具体的な日と場所を提案してみて。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: I made a friend by sharing fries. Just saying.
replies.translation: ポテトを分けたら友達できたよ。参考までに。

posts.author: Night Owl
posts.text: My best ideas arrive at 2 a.m. My worst decisions follow at 2:05.
posts.translation: 最高のアイデアは午前2時に来る。最悪の決断は2時5分に来る。

replies.author: Mellow Moon
replies.text: Please sleep before 2:05.
replies.translation: 2時5分になる前に寝て。

posts.author: Bookish Fox
posts.text: I bought a beautiful notebook. Now I'm afraid to write in it.
posts.translation: きれいなノートを買った。もったいなくて書き込めない。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: The first messy page is the hardest.
replies.translation: 最初のぐちゃぐちゃなページが一番難しいんだよ。

replies.author: Tiny Dragon
replies.text: Write "hello". The spell is broken.
replies.translation: 「こんにちは」って書こう。それで呪いが解ける。

posts.author: Rainy Rabbit
posts.text: I canceled my plans and immediately missed the plans I canceled.
posts.translation: 予定をキャンセルした瞬間、その予定が恋しくなった。

replies.author: Mellow Moon
replies.text: The human brain is a strange place.
replies.translation: 人間の脳って変なところだね。

posts.author: Wise Owl
posts.text: Resting isn't the same as giving up. Sometimes rest is how you keep going.
posts.translation: 休むことは諦めることとは違う。休息が前に進む力になることもある。

replies.author: Lost in My 20s
replies.text: I'm saving this one.
replies.translation: これ保存しておく。

posts.author: Office Ghost
posts.text: I replied "Sounds good!" and now I have no idea what I agreed to.
posts.translation: 「いいですね！」って返信したけど、何に同意したのかわからない。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: The classic professional mistake.
replies.translation: 社会人の定番ミスだね。

posts.author: Mellow Moon
posts.text: Today wasn't amazing, but I saw a very small dog wearing a very big coat.
posts.translation: 今日は最高の日ではなかった。でも大きなコートを着た小さな犬を見た。

replies.author: Rainy Rabbit
replies.text: That counts as a good day.
replies.translation: それはいい日ってことでいいよ。

posts.author: Lost in My 20s
posts.text: Is it okay to change careers even if you're not sure what comes next?
posts.translation: 次に何をするか決まってなくても、仕事を変えていいのかな？

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: It's okay to explore, but make a plan for your basic needs.
replies.translation: 模索していいと思う。でも生活に必要なことは計画してね。

replies.author: Office Ghost
replies.text: Talking to someone in that field helped me.
replies.translation: その業界の人に話を聞くと役に立ったよ。

posts.author: Monday Survivor
posts.text: My calendar says "free time." I don't remember agreeing to that.
posts.translation: カレンダーに「自由時間」って書いてある。そんな約束した覚えはない。

replies.author: Night Owl
replies.text: Free time is suspicious. Be careful.
replies.translation: 自由時間は怪しい。気をつけて。

posts.author: Bookish Fox
posts.text: I'm reading three books at once and finishing absolutely none of them.
posts.translation: 3冊同時に読んでるけど、どれも全然読み終わらない。

replies.author: Mellow Moon
replies.text: Sounds like three wonderful beginnings.
replies.translation: 素敵な始まりが3つあるってことだね。

posts.author: Rainy Rabbit
posts.text: Someone remembered a tiny detail about me today. It made my whole week.
posts.translation: 今日、誰かが私の小さな話を覚えていてくれた。それだけで一週間が幸せになった。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: Being remembered feels wonderful.
replies.translation: 覚えてもらえるって嬉しいよね。

posts.author: Coffee Goblin
posts.text: I made coffee and forgot where I put it. This is my origin story.
posts.translation: コーヒーを入れて、どこに置いたか忘れた。これが私の誕生秘話。

replies.author: Tiny Dragon
replies.text: Check the refrigerator.
replies.translation: 冷蔵庫を見てみて。

posts.author: Wise Owl
posts.text: If your friend told you your own story, would you be kinder to them?
posts.translation: 友達があなたと同じ悩みを話したら、もっと優しく接するんじゃない？

replies.author: Lost in My 20s
replies.text: Wow. I hadn't thought of it like that.
replies.translation: わあ。そんなふうに考えたことなかった。

posts.author: Office Ghost
posts.text: My inbox has 27 unread messages, but I have achieved inner peace by ignoring them.
posts.translation: 未読メールが27通ある。でも無視することで心の平和を得た。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: Peace is good. Deadlines are real, though.
replies.translation: 平和はいいね。でも締切も現実だよ。

posts.author: Sleepy Cat
posts.text: The human bought me a bed. I'm sleeping in the box it came in.
posts.translation: 人間がベッドを買ってくれた。私はその箱で寝ている。

replies.author: Tiny Dragon
replies.text: A classic architectural choice.
replies.translation: 定番の建築的選択だね。

posts.author: Dog Detective
posts.text: My human said "walk". I have been ready for 45 minutes.
posts.translation: 人間が「散歩」と言った。45分前から準備万端だ。

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.text: That sounds like a lot of effort.
replies.translation: ずいぶん頑張るね。

posts.author: Penguin Intern
posts.text: I slipped on the ice again. I literally live here.
posts.translation: また氷で滑った。ここに住んでるのに。

replies.author: Dog Detective
replies.text: Practice makes progress!
replies.translation: 練習すれば上達するよ！

posts.author: Sleepy Cat
posts.text: I knocked a cup off the table. Science requires experiments.
posts.translation: テーブルからカップを落とした。科学には実験が必要だ。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: Please publish your findings.
replies.translation: ぜひ研究結果を発表して。

posts.author: Garden Snail
posts.text: Everyone is in a hurry. I have visited one leaf today and it was lovely.
posts.translation: みんな急いでいる。私は今日葉っぱを1枚訪ねた。素敵だった。

replies.author: Mellow Moon
replies.text: I want your lifestyle.
replies.translation: その暮らしに憧れる。

posts.author: Dog Detective
posts.text: There is a suspicious squirrel outside. I will investigate by barking at the window.
posts.translation: 外に怪しいリスがいる。窓に向かって吠えて捜査する。

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.text: Please investigate quietly.
replies.translation: 静かに捜査して。

posts.author: Sleepy Cat
posts.text: I asked for food. The human gave me the food I asked for. Unacceptable.
posts.translation: ご飯を要求した。人間は要求したご飯を出した。許せない。

replies.author: Dog Detective
replies.text: Can I have it?
replies.translation: それ、もらっていい？

posts.author: Penguin Intern
posts.text: I tried to fly. The results were consistent with previous research.
posts.translation: 飛ぼうとしてみた。結果は過去の研究と一致した。

replies.author: Garden Snail
replies.text: I believe in your next experiment.
replies.translation: 次の実験も応援してる。

posts.author: Garden Snail
posts.text: Today's weather: one drop of rain. This is a major event for me.
posts.translation: 今日の天気は雨粒ひとつ。私にとっては大事件だ。

replies.author: Rainy Rabbit
replies.text: Stay safe out there!
replies.translation: 気をつけてね！

posts.author: Dog Detective
posts.text: I found the missing sock. It was in my mouth the entire time.
posts.translation: なくなった靴下を発見した。ずっと自分の口の中にあった。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: Case closed.
replies.translation: 事件解決だね。

posts.author: Sleepy Cat
posts.text: If you wanted to use the keyboard, why did you leave it warm and empty?
posts.translation: キーボードを使いたかったの？じゃあなんで温かいまま空けておいたの？

replies.author: Office Ghost
replies.text: Please send that message to my boss.
replies.translation: その言葉、上司に送って。

posts.author: Penguin Intern
posts.text: My job interview went badly. They asked if I could work in a warm office.
posts.translation: 面接はうまくいかなかった。暖かいオフィスで働けるか聞かれた。

replies.author: Garden Snail
replies.text: That sounds like a deal-breaker.
replies.translation: それは譲れない条件だね。

posts.author: Dog Detective
posts.text: I love every person I've ever met, except the vacuum cleaner.
posts.translation: 出会った人は全員大好き。ただし掃除機は除く。

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.text: We finally agree on something.
replies.translation: ついに意見が一致した。

posts.author: Garden Snail
posts.text: I reached the other side of the path. My family is very proud.
posts.translation: 道の反対側に着いた。家族がとても誇りに思っている。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: What an achievement!
replies.translation: なんて立派な達成だろう！

posts.author: Sleepy Cat
posts.text: Do not disturb me. Unless you have snacks. Then disturb me immediately.
posts.translation: 邪魔しないで。おやつがある場合を除く。その場合は即座に邪魔して。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: Honestly, same.
replies.translation: 正直、私も同じ。

posts.author: Dog Detective
posts.text: The delivery person came back! My barking did not stop them last time.
posts.translation: 配達の人がまた来た！前回の吠え声でも止められなかった。

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.text: Your security system needs work.
replies.translation: 警備システムの改善が必要だね。

posts.author: Penguin Intern
posts.text: Does anybody know how to look professional while waddling?
posts.translation: よちよち歩きながらプロっぽく見せる方法、誰か知らない？

replies.author: Office Ghost
replies.text: Carry a clipboard. Works for me.
replies.translation: クリップボードを持つといいよ。私はそれでいけてる。

posts.author: Garden Snail
posts.text: I brought my house with me. Housing costs are finally under control.
posts.translation: 家を持ってきた。ついに住宅費の管理に成功した。

replies.author: Lost in My 20s
replies.text: Please teach me your financial strategy.
replies.translation: その家計術を教えてください。

posts.author: Sleepy Cat
posts.text: My human is worried because I stared at a wall for twenty minutes. The wall knows why.
posts.translation: 20分も壁を見つめていたら人間が心配し始めた。理由は壁が知っている。

replies.author: Tiny Dragon
replies.text: Now I'm worried too.
replies.translation: 私も心配になってきた。

posts.author: Dog Detective
posts.text: I learned a new trick today: pretending not to hear "bath time."
posts.translation: 今日新しい芸を覚えた。「お風呂だよ」が聞こえないふりをする芸だ。

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.text: A useful life skill.
replies.translation: 人生で役立つスキルだね。

posts.author: Jazz Cat
posts.text: I practiced the same four bars for an hour. They're finally beginning to sound like music.
posts.translation: 同じ4小節を1時間練習した。ようやく音楽っぽくなってきた。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: Small progress is still progress.
replies.translation: 小さな進歩も立派な進歩だよ。

posts.author: Sax Problems
posts.text: My reed was perfect yesterday. Today it has chosen violence.
posts.translation: 昨日は完璧だったリードが、今日は反抗している。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: Reeds have moods. I'm convinced.
replies.translation: リードには機嫌がある。絶対そう。

posts.author: Tenor Turtle
posts.text: The tenor sax is heavy, but my love for it is heavier.
posts.translation: テナーサックスは重い。でも愛はもっと重い。

replies.author: Alto Fox
replies.text: My shoulders disagree.
replies.translation: 私の肩は反対してる。

posts.author: Alto Fox
posts.text: Someone asked if my saxophone was a trumpet. I smiled politely.
posts.translation: サックスをトランペットかと聞かれた。礼儀正しく微笑んだ。

replies.author: Sax Problems
replies.text: You showed incredible self-control.
replies.translation: すごい自制心だね。

posts.author: Jazz Cat
posts.text: I finally played that fast passage cleanly. Nobody was there to hear it.
posts.translation: ついに速いフレーズをきれいに吹けた。誰も聞いてなかった。

replies.author: Tenor Turtle
replies.text: The universe heard you.
replies.translation: 宇宙は聞いてたよ。

posts.author: Soprano Star
posts.text: Why does everyone think the soprano sax is easy to play in tune?
posts.translation: どうしてみんな、ソプラノサックスは音程を合わせやすいと思うんだろう？

replies.author: Alto Fox
replies.text: Who thinks that? Send them to me.
replies.translation: 誰がそんなこと思ってるの？連れてきて。

posts.author: Baritone Bear
posts.text: I carried my baritone sax upstairs. That was my workout for the week.
posts.translation: バリトンサックスを階段で運んだ。今週の筋トレ終了。

replies.author: Tenor Turtle
replies.text: Respect. Please hydrate.
replies.translation: 尊敬する。水分補給してね。

posts.author: Jazz Cat
posts.text: Listening to Charlie Parker makes me want to practice and quit at the same time.
posts.translation: チャーリー・パーカーを聴くと、練習したくなるし辞めたくもなる。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: Let inspiration win over comparison.
replies.translation: 比較より刺激を大切にしよう。

posts.author: Sax Problems
posts.text: I bought one reed. Somehow I left the store with five other things.
posts.translation: リードを1枚買いに行った。なぜか別の物を5つも買って帰った。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: Music stores are dangerous places.
replies.translation: 楽器店は危険な場所だ。

posts.author: Alto Fox
posts.text: The alto sax is smaller than the tenor, but it still takes up my entire life.
posts.translation: アルトはテナーより小さい。でも私の人生を丸ごと占領している。

replies.author: Tenor Turtle
replies.text: That's a fair comparison.
replies.translation: その比較は正しいね。

posts.author: Soprano Star
posts.text: I played one note in tune today. Please celebrate responsibly.
posts.translation: 今日は音程の合った音をひとつ出せた。節度を持ってお祝いして。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: I'm throwing a tiny parade.
replies.translation: 小さなパレードを開くよ。

posts.author: Baritone Bear
posts.text: People say they love a deep sound until I play the lowest note in the room.
posts.translation: 低い音が好きってみんな言うけど、部屋で一番低い音を吹くと話が違う。

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.text: My nap has been interrupted.
replies.translation: 昼寝を邪魔された。

posts.author: Jazz Cat
posts.text: Tonight I'm playing Confirmation. My fingers are nervous, but I'm excited.
posts.translation: 今夜は『Confirmation』を演奏する。指は緊張しているけど楽しみだ。

replies.author: Alto Fox
replies.text: You've got this. Have fun!
replies.translation: 大丈夫。楽しんで！

posts.author: Tenor Turtle
posts.text: I can play the melody perfectly until someone says, "Record it."
posts.translation: メロディーは完璧に吹ける。「録音するよ」と言われるまでは。

replies.author: Sax Problems
replies.text: The red recording light is my enemy.
replies.translation: 録音中の赤いランプは敵だ。

posts.author: Alto Fox
posts.text: My neighbors heard my scales again. I hope they're learning something.
posts.translation: 近所の人はまた私の音階練習を聞いた。何か学んでくれてるといいな。

replies.author: Office Ghost
replies.text: They can probably sing B-flat now.
replies.translation: もう変ロ音を歌えると思う。

posts.author: Soprano Star
posts.text: I tried a new mouthpiece and suddenly forgot how to play the instrument.
posts.translation: 新しいマウスピースを試したら、突然楽器の吹き方を忘れた。

replies.author: Baritone Bear
replies.text: Give it a little time.
replies.translation: 少し慣れる時間をあげて。

posts.author: Jazz Cat
posts.text: Improvisation is making confident decisions before your brain catches up.
posts.translation: 即興演奏は、脳が追いつく前に自信満々に決断すること。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: That's a surprisingly good definition.
replies.translation: 驚くほどいい定義だね。

posts.author: Sax Problems
posts.text: I forgot my neck strap and discovered a new kind of panic.
posts.translation: ネックストラップを忘れて、新しい種類のパニックを知った。

replies.author: Tenor Turtle
replies.text: That is a true emergency.
replies.translation: それは本当に緊急事態だ。

posts.author: Baritone Bear
posts.text: My instrument case has wheels. I still feel like I'm moving furniture.
posts.translation: 楽器ケースに車輪が付いてる。それでも家具を運んでる気分だ。

replies.author: Alto Fox
replies.text: At least the furniture makes music.
replies.translation: 少なくともその家具は音楽を奏でる。

posts.author: Jazz Cat
posts.text: Earlier today, my solo was a mess. Tonight, it sounded better. I'll take it.
posts.translation: 今日の早い時間のソロはめちゃくちゃだった。今夜は少し良かった。それで十分。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: That's how improvement sounds.
replies.translation: それが上達の音だよ。

posts.author: Coffee Goblin
posts.text: I said I'd save money this week. Then a new bakery opened.
posts.translation: 今週は節約すると宣言した。すると新しいパン屋がオープンした。

replies.author: Mellow Moon
replies.text: That sounds like an unavoidable expense.
replies.translation: それは避けられない出費だね。

posts.author: Pizza Philosopher
posts.text: Cold pizza for breakfast is not a mistake. It's a lifestyle.
posts.translation: 朝食に冷たいピザを食べるのは間違いじゃない。生き方だ。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: I respect your philosophy, with reservations.
replies.translation: その哲学には一部留保しつつ敬意を表する。

posts.author: Noodle Wizard
posts.text: I ordered spicy noodles. The noodles won.
posts.translation: 辛い麺を注文した。麺の勝ちだった。

replies.author: Tiny Dragon
replies.text: Did you survive?
replies.translation: 生き残った？

replies.author: Noodle Wizard
replies.text: Barely. Worth it.
replies.translation: ギリギリね。でもその価値はあった。

posts.author: Toast Captain
posts.text: I burned toast so badly that the smoke alarm reviewed my cooking.
posts.translation: トーストをひどく焦がして、火災報知器に料理を評価された。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: One star. Very loud service.
replies.translation: 星1つ。サービスがとてもうるさい。

posts.author: Pizza Philosopher
posts.text: Pineapple on pizza: a controversial topic that has somehow survived generations.
posts.translation: ピザにパイナップル。なぜか世代を超えて続く論争。

replies.author: Noodle Wizard
replies.text: I just want extra cheese.
replies.translation: 私はチーズ増量がいい。

posts.author: Coffee Goblin
posts.text: The café wrote my name wrong. I am now officially "Goblin Coffee."
posts.translation: カフェが名前を間違えた。今日から正式に「ゴブリン・コーヒー」だ。

replies.author: Toast Captain
replies.text: Honestly, a strong brand.
replies.translation: 正直、いいブランド名だよ。

posts.author: Noodle Wizard
posts.text: I tried cooking without a recipe. The result was educational, not edible.
posts.translation: レシピなしで料理してみた。結果は食用ではなく教育用だった。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: What did you learn?
replies.translation: 何を学んだの？

replies.author: Noodle Wizard
replies.text: Follow the recipe.
replies.translation: レシピに従うこと。

posts.author: Toast Captain
posts.text: My sandwich fell apart. I guess it's a salad now.
posts.translation: サンドイッチが崩れた。もうサラダってことにしよう。

replies.author: Pizza Philosopher
replies.text: Every meal is a chance to adapt.
replies.translation: 食事はすべて適応のチャンスだ。

posts.author: Coffee Goblin
posts.text: I don't need another mug. I need somewhere to put the mugs I already have.
posts.translation: マグカップはもう要らない。今あるマグを置く場所が必要。

replies.author: Bookish Fox
replies.text: This is me with notebooks.
replies.translation: 私の場合はノートだ。

posts.author: Pizza Philosopher
posts.text: The pizza box says "serves four." It doesn't know me.
posts.translation: ピザの箱には「4人分」とある。私のことを知らないな。

replies.author: Dog Detective
replies.text: I believe in you.
replies.translation: 信じてるよ。

posts.author: Noodle Wizard
posts.text: There are two kinds of people: those who share fries and those who regret it.
posts.translation: 世の中には2種類の人がいる。ポテトを分ける人と、後悔する人だ。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: I count every fry.
replies.translation: 私はポテトを1本ずつ数える。

posts.author: Toast Captain
posts.text: I made breakfast in bed. Mostly crumbs in bed.
posts.translation: ベッドで朝食を作った。というか、ベッドをパンくずだらけにした。

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.text: A beautiful disaster.
replies.translation: 美しい惨事だ。

posts.author: Pizza Philosopher
posts.text: Is soup a drink? Please be kind in the replies.
posts.translation: スープは飲み物？リプライ欄では優しくしてね。

replies.author: Noodle Wizard
replies.text: Soup is soup. Let soup be free.
replies.translation: スープはスープ。自由にしてあげよう。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: I appreciate this peaceful answer.
replies.translation: 平和な答えで助かる。

posts.author: Coffee Goblin
posts.text: My coffee is too hot, so I wait. Then I forget it exists until it's cold.
posts.translation: コーヒーが熱すぎるから待つ。存在を忘れて冷たくなる。

replies.author: Mellow Moon
replies.text: The eternal coffee cycle.
replies.translation: 永遠のコーヒー循環。

posts.author: Noodle Wizard
posts.text: I found a tiny restaurant with amazing food and only three tables.
posts.translation: テーブルが3つしかない小さな食堂を見つけた。料理が最高だった。

replies.author: Pizza Philosopher
replies.text: Those places can be treasures.
replies.translation: そういう店って宝物みたいだよね。

posts.author: Toast Captain
posts.text: Today I learned that "a pinch of salt" is not a mountain of salt.
posts.translation: 今日学んだこと。「塩ひとつまみ」は塩の山ではない。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: A valuable lesson.
replies.translation: 貴重な教訓だね。

posts.author: Coffee Goblin
posts.text: Someone asked whether I wanted tea or coffee. I panicked and said "yes."
posts.translation: 紅茶かコーヒーか聞かれて、慌てて「はい」と言った。

replies.author: Toast Captain
replies.text: A perfectly reasonable answer.
replies.translation: 完全に合理的な答えだ。

posts.author: Pizza Philosopher
posts.text: I offered someone the last slice. They took it. I wasn't emotionally prepared.
posts.translation: 最後の一切れを誰かに勧めたら、本当に取られた。心の準備ができてなかった。

replies.author: Mellow Moon
replies.text: Your generosity was tested.
replies.translation: 優しさを試されたね。

posts.author: Noodle Wizard
posts.text: I made enough pasta for six people. I live alone.
posts.translation: 6人分のパスタを作った。一人暮らしなのに。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: Congratulations on tomorrow's lunch.
replies.translation: 明日のお昼が決まったね。

posts.author: Toast Captain
posts.text: I bought a fancy knife and still cut vegetables like a confused penguin.
posts.translation: 高級包丁を買ったのに、戸惑うペンギンみたいに野菜を切ってる。

replies.author: Penguin Intern
replies.text: Why am I involved in this?
replies.translation: なんで私が巻き込まれてるの？

posts.author: Space Potato
posts.text: The moon is moving away from Earth very slowly. Even the moon needs personal space.
posts.translation: 月は少しずつ地球から遠ざかっている。月にも自分の空間が必要なんだね。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: A strangely relatable astronomy fact.
replies.translation: 妙に共感できる天文学の話だね。

posts.author: Tech Gremlin
posts.text: I fixed the printer by turning it off and on. Please call me a wizard.
posts.translation: 電源を切って入れ直したらプリンターが直った。魔法使いと呼んで。

replies.author: Noodle Wizard
replies.text: Welcome to the guild.
replies.translation: 魔法使い組合へようこそ。

posts.author: Bookish Fox
posts.text: I went to the library for one book and left with seven. The math is mysterious.
posts.translation: 図書館に1冊借りに行って7冊持って帰った。計算が謎だ。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: Book math works differently.
replies.translation: 本の計算は別ルールなんだよ。

posts.author: Rainy Rabbit
posts.text: The smell after rain has a name: petrichor. That's a beautiful word.
posts.translation: 雨上がりの匂いには「ペトリコール」という名前がある。素敵な言葉だね。

replies.author: Bookish Fox
replies.text: Adding that to my favorite words.
replies.translation: お気に入りの単語に追加する。

posts.author: Tech Gremlin
posts.text: My phone battery lasts all day, except on days when I actually need it.
posts.translation: スマホの電池は一日もつ。本当に必要な日を除いて。

replies.author: Office Ghost
replies.text: Technology has a sense of humor.
replies.translation: テクノロジーにはユーモアがあるね。

posts.author: Space Potato
posts.text: If aliens visit Earth, I hope we don't introduce them to reply sections first.
posts.translation: 宇宙人が地球に来たら、最初にリプライ欄を見せないでほしい。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: Let's start with music instead.
replies.translation: まずは音楽から紹介しよう。

posts.author: Bookish Fox
posts.text: I looked up one word in the dictionary and somehow learned twelve unrelated facts.
posts.translation: 辞書でひとつ単語を調べたら、関係ない知識を12個覚えた。

replies.author: Rainy Rabbit
replies.text: That's the best kind of detour.
replies.translation: そういう寄り道が一番いい。

posts.author: Rainy Rabbit
posts.text: I took a photo of the sky because the clouds looked like a sleepy dragon.
posts.translation: 雲が眠そうなドラゴンみたいだったから空の写真を撮った。

replies.author: Tiny Dragon
replies.text: That's my cousin.
replies.translation: それ私のいとこ。

posts.author: Tech Gremlin
posts.text: My laptop asked me to restart for an update. I asked it to reconsider.
posts.translation: パソコンが更新のため再起動しろと言ってきた。考え直してと頼んだ。

replies.author: Office Ghost
replies.text: Did it listen?
replies.translation: 聞いてくれた？

replies.author: Tech Gremlin
replies.text: Absolutely not.
replies.translation: まったく。

posts.author: Space Potato
posts.text: A day on Venus is longer than its year. That calendar must be confusing.
posts.translation: 金星では1日が1年より長い。カレンダーがややこしそう。

replies.author: Monday Survivor
replies.text: Does that mean fewer Mondays?
replies.translation: じゃあ月曜日が減るの？

posts.author: Bookish Fox
posts.text: Sometimes I read the same sentence four times because my mind is on vacation.
posts.translation: 頭が休暇中なので、同じ一文を4回読むことがある。

replies.author: Mellow Moon
replies.text: Your brain deserves a postcard.
replies.translation: 脳から絵はがきが届きそう。

posts.author: Rainy Rabbit
posts.text: My umbrella turned inside out. The wind has won this round.
posts.translation: 傘が裏返った。今回は風の勝ちだ。

replies.author: Garden Snail
replies.text: I recommend a portable house.
replies.translation: 持ち運べる家をおすすめする。

posts.author: Tech Gremlin
posts.text: I have 86 browser tabs open. Each one represents a different version of me.
posts.translation: ブラウザのタブが86個開いている。どれも別バージョンの私だ。

replies.author: Bookish Fox
replies.text: Which one is doing the work?
replies.translation: 仕事してるのはどの自分？

posts.author: Space Potato
posts.text: If you could visit any planet, which one would you choose? Earth counts.
posts.translation: どの惑星でも行けるなら、どこを選ぶ？地球もあり。

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.text: Earth. My food bowl is here.
replies.translation: 地球。ご飯の皿がここにある。

posts.author: Bookish Fox
posts.text: I love bookstores that have little handwritten notes recommending books.
posts.translation: 本をおすすめする手書きメモが置いてある書店が好き。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: It's like getting advice from a stranger who loves stories.
replies.translation: 物語好きな知らない人から助言をもらうみたいだね。

posts.author: Rainy Rabbit
posts.text: A stranger held the door for me, so I held it for someone else. Tiny kindness chain.
posts.translation: 知らない人がドアを押さえてくれたので、私も次の人にそうした。小さな親切の連鎖。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: That's how a good day spreads.
replies.translation: そうやっていい一日が広がっていくんだね。

posts.author: Tech Gremlin
posts.text: I searched for "how to focus" and got distracted by an article about octopuses.
posts.translation: 「集中する方法」を検索して、タコの記事に気を取られた。

replies.author: Space Potato
replies.text: Octopuses are very interesting, to be fair.
replies.translation: まあタコは本当に面白いからね。

posts.author: Space Potato
posts.text: Stars look peaceful from here. They're actually extremely dramatic.
posts.translation: 星はここからだと穏やかに見える。実際はとても激しい。

replies.author: Tiny Dragon
replies.text: I respect their energy.
replies.translation: そのエネルギー、尊敬する。

posts.author: Bookish Fox
posts.text: I started learning English to watch videos without subtitles. Now I read comments for fun.
posts.translation: 字幕なしで動画を見るために英語を始めた。今はコメント欄を楽しんで読んでる。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: That's an excellent side effect.
replies.translation: それは素晴らしい副作用だね。

posts.author: Rainy Rabbit
posts.text: Someone said "take your time" today. I almost cried. I really needed to hear it.
posts.translation: 今日「ゆっくりでいいよ」と言われて泣きそうになった。本当に必要な言葉だった。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: Then here's one more: you're allowed to go slowly.
replies.translation: じゃあもうひとつ。ゆっくり進んでいいんだよ。

posts.author: Mellow Moon
posts.text: I cleaned my desk to feel productive. Now I can't find my favorite pen.
posts.translation: 生産的な気分になりたくて机を片づけた。お気に入りのペンが見つからない。

replies.author: Office Ghost
replies.text: Organizing is just hiding things from yourself.
replies.translation: 整理整頓って、自分から物を隠すことだよね。

posts.author: Lost in My 20s
posts.text: Is it weird to start a new hobby when you're already bad at so many things?
posts.translation: 苦手なことが山ほどあるのに、新しい趣味を始めるのって変かな？

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: Being bad at something new is part of being alive.
replies.translation: 新しいことが下手なのも、生きている証拠だよ。

posts.author: Monday Survivor
posts.text: My calendar says it's Tuesday, but emotionally it's still Monday.
posts.translation: カレンダーは火曜日と言ってるけど、気持ちはまだ月曜日。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: Some Mondays last three business days.
replies.translation: 月曜日って営業日で3日続くことあるよね。

posts.author: Bookish Fox
posts.text: I read the same page four times. My brain is somewhere else today.
posts.translation: 同じページを4回読んだ。今日は頭がどこか別の場所にいる。

replies.author: Rainy Rabbit
replies.text: Maybe your brain went on a little trip without you.
replies.translation: 頭だけ先に小旅行に出かけたのかもね。

posts.author: Office Ghost
posts.text: Someone booked a meeting to discuss whether we need fewer meetings.
posts.translation: 会議を減らすべきか話し合う会議が設定された。

replies.author: Tech Gremlin
replies.text: Please tell me there will be a follow-up meeting.
replies.translation: ぜひ、その後の会議もあると言って。

posts.author: Rainy Rabbit
posts.text: I wanted to say no, but I said maybe. How do people do this?
posts.translation: 断りたかったのに、たぶんって言っちゃった。みんなどうやって断ってるの？

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: You can start with, "I can't this time." That's enough.
replies.translation: 「今回はできません」で始めていいんだよ。それで十分。

posts.author: Night Owl
posts.text: I made a perfect bedtime plan. Then I watched one more video.
posts.translation: 完璧な就寝計画を立てた。そのあと動画をもう一本見た。

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.text: The last video is never the last video.
replies.translation: 最後の一本が最後だったことなんてない。

posts.author: Mellow Moon
posts.text: A stranger held the door for me today. Such a tiny thing, such a nice feeling.
posts.translation: 今日は知らない人がドアを押さえてくれた。小さなことだけど、いい気分。

replies.author: Rainy Rabbit
replies.text: Little kindnesses make a big difference.
replies.translation: 小さな親切って大きな違いを生むよね。

posts.author: Lost in My 20s
posts.text: My friend got a promotion. I'm happy for her, but I feel left behind.
posts.translation: 友達が昇進した。うれしいけど、自分だけ取り残された気がする。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: You can celebrate her and still feel uncertain about your own path.
replies.translation: 友達を祝福しつつ、自分の道に不安を感じてもいいんだよ。

posts.author: Office Ghost
posts.text: I sent an email without the attachment. Again. The attachment is apparently shy.
posts.translation: 添付ファイルなしでメールを送った。まただ。添付ファイルは恥ずかしがり屋らしい。

replies.author: Tech Gremlin
replies.text: My attachments only appear after I apologize.
replies.translation: 私の添付ファイルも謝罪メールを送ったあとにしか現れない。

posts.author: Bookish Fox
posts.text: I finally finished a book I started last winter. That counts as a victory.
posts.translation: 去年の冬に読み始めた本をようやく読み終えた。これは勝利だよね。

replies.author: Mellow Moon
replies.text: A slow victory is still a victory.
replies.translation: ゆっくりでも勝利は勝利だよ。

posts.author: Monday Survivor
posts.text: I tried taking a short walk during lunch. Honestly, it helped more than I expected.
posts.translation: 昼休みに少し歩いてみた。正直、思った以上に効果があった。

replies.author: Rainy Rabbit
replies.text: Fresh air is surprisingly persuasive.
replies.translation: 外の空気って意外と説得力あるよね。

posts.author: Rainy Rabbit
posts.text: I want to be good at something immediately. Being a beginner is uncomfortable.
posts.translation: 何かをすぐ上手にできるようになりたい。初心者でいるのは落ち着かない。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: Every good solo started with a wrong note somewhere.
replies.translation: いいソロにも、どこかで間違えた音から始まった時期があるよ。

posts.author: Coffee Goblin
posts.text: A coworker said "quick question." It was not quick, and it wasn't one question.
posts.translation: 同僚が「ちょっと質問」と言った。ちょっとでもないし、質問は一つでもなかった。

replies.author: Office Ghost
replies.text: That phrase should come with a warning label.
replies.translation: その言葉には警告ラベルが必要だね。

posts.author: Bookish Fox
posts.text: Does anyone else practice conversations in their head before making a phone call?
posts.translation: 電話する前に頭の中で会話を練習する人、ほかにもいる？

replies.author: Lost in My 20s
replies.text: Yes. Then the person answers differently and my script disappears.
replies.translation: いるよ。相手の返事が予想と違うと台本が消える。

posts.author: Mellow Moon
posts.text: I found an old photo and remembered a day I'd completely forgotten.
posts.translation: 古い写真を見つけて、すっかり忘れていた一日を思い出した。

replies.author: Bookish Fox
replies.text: Photos are little time machines.
replies.translation: 写真は小さなタイムマシンだね。

posts.author: Lost in My 20s
posts.text: I said yes to too many plans this weekend. How can relaxing be so stressful?
posts.translation: 週末の予定を入れすぎた。休むことがどうしてこんなにストレスになるの？

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: Rest doesn't have to be another task on your list.
replies.translation: 休息までやることリストに入れなくていいんだよ。

posts.author: Office Ghost
posts.text: My computer restarted right before I saved my work. We are no longer friends.
posts.translation: 保存する直前にパソコンが再起動した。もう友達じゃない。

replies.author: Tech Gremlin
replies.text: I recommend a long, serious talk with the save button.
replies.translation: 保存ボタンと長く真剣に話し合うことをおすすめする。

posts.author: Rainy Rabbit
posts.text: I asked for help today instead of pretending I understood everything.
posts.translation: 今日は全部わかったふりをせず、助けを求めてみた。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: That sounds like confidence, not weakness.
replies.translation: それは弱さじゃなくて、自信に聞こえるよ。

posts.author: Monday Survivor
posts.text: I made it through a hard week. No big achievement, just made it through.
posts.translation: 大変な一週間を乗り切った。大きな成果はないけど、乗り切った。

replies.author: Mellow Moon
replies.text: Sometimes getting through is the achievement.
replies.translation: 乗り切ること自体が成果のときもあるよ。

posts.author: Sleepy Cat
posts.text: My human bought me a fancy bed. I choose the cardboard box.
posts.translation: 人間が高級ベッドを買ってくれた。私は段ボール箱を選ぶ。

replies.author: Dog Detective
replies.text: I would like to investigate this box.
replies.translation: その箱を捜査したい。

posts.author: Dog Detective
posts.text: I heard a suspicious sound in the kitchen. It was my own stomach.
posts.translation: 台所で怪しい音がした。自分のお腹だった。

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.text: Case closed. Feed the detective.
replies.translation: 事件解決。探偵にごはんをあげて。

posts.author: Penguin Intern
posts.text: I attended my first meeting. Nobody mentioned the fish budget.
posts.translation: 初めての会議に出た。誰も魚の予算に触れなかった。

replies.author: Office Ghost
replies.text: Sounds exactly like our meetings.
replies.translation: まさにうちの会議みたい。

posts.author: Garden Snail
posts.text: Everyone is rushing somewhere. I arrived at my leaf right on time.
posts.translation: みんな急いでどこかへ行く。私は葉っぱにぴったり時間通り到着した。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: Your schedule sounds peaceful.
replies.translation: 君の予定は穏やかそうだね。

posts.author: Sleepy Cat
posts.text: I sat on the keyboard and improved my human's writing. You're welcome.
posts.translation: キーボードに座って人間の文章を改善した。どういたしまして。

replies.author: Tech Gremlin
replies.text: Please stop submitting bug reports with your paws.
replies.translation: 肉球でバグ報告を送るのはやめて。

posts.author: Dog Detective
posts.text: There is a mysterious person behind the mirror. They copy everything I do.
posts.translation: 鏡の向こうに謎の人物がいる。私の動きを全部まねしてくる。

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.text: Have you tried ignoring the suspect?
replies.translation: 容疑者を無視してみた？

posts.author: Rainy Rabbit
posts.text: I bought a tiny umbrella for my imaginary rabbit friend. This is my life now.
posts.translation: 架空のウサギ友達に小さな傘を買った。今の私の人生はこうだ。

replies.author: Garden Snail
replies.text: Does your friend need a tiny raincoat too?
replies.translation: その友達には小さなレインコートも必要かな？

posts.author: Penguin Intern
posts.text: I wore a tie today. Nobody noticed because I'm already wearing a tuxedo.
posts.translation: 今日はネクタイをした。もともとタキシード姿だから誰にも気づかれなかった。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: Your office dress code is impossible.
replies.translation: 君の職場の服装規定、難しすぎるね。

posts.author: Sleepy Cat
posts.text: The sun moved across the floor. I had to move my entire nap.
posts.translation: 床の日なたが移動した。昼寝の場所を全部移さなきゃいけなかった。

replies.author: Mellow Moon
replies.text: Such a demanding schedule.
replies.translation: なんて忙しい予定なんだ。

posts.author: Dog Detective
posts.text: The mail carrier returned today. Clearly my warnings are not working.
posts.translation: 今日も郵便配達の人が来た。どうやら警告が効いていない。

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.text: Have you considered writing a formal complaint?
replies.translation: 正式な苦情を書いてみたら？

posts.author: Garden Snail
posts.text: I crossed the whole path today. Please don't ask how long it took.
posts.translation: 今日は小道を全部渡りきった。何時間かかったかは聞かないで。

replies.author: Tenor Turtle
replies.text: I respect your commitment to slow travel.
replies.translation: ゆっくり旅をする君の姿勢を尊敬するよ。

posts.author: Penguin Intern
posts.text: Someone called me cool. Finally, my natural temperature is appreciated.
posts.translation: 誰かが私をクールと言った。やっと私の体温が評価された。

replies.author: Tiny Dragon
replies.text: I have the opposite problem.
replies.translation: 私は逆の悩みを抱えてるよ。

posts.author: Sleepy Cat
posts.text: I knocked over a glass. My human calls it chaos. I call it science.
posts.translation: コップを倒した。人間は大惨事と言うけど、私は科学と呼ぶ。

replies.author: Dog Detective
replies.text: Did you collect any useful evidence?
replies.translation: 何か有益な証拠は集まった？

posts.author: Dog Detective
posts.text: I found the missing sock. It was inside my bed. No further questions.
posts.translation: 行方不明の靴下を発見。私のベッドの中にあった。質問は受け付けない。

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.text: The detective is also the main suspect.
replies.translation: 探偵が第一容疑者でもあるね。

posts.author: Garden Snail
posts.text: My plant grew a new leaf. I feel like a proud neighbor.
posts.translation: 私の植物に新しい葉が生えた。誇らしい隣人になった気分。

replies.author: Rainy Rabbit
replies.text: Tell the leaf we said hello!
replies.translation: 葉っぱによろしく伝えて！

posts.author: Penguin Intern
posts.text: My boss asked me to break the ice. I thought that was my whole job.
posts.translation: 上司に場を和ませてと言われた。それが自分の仕事の全部だと思ってた。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: You're naturally qualified.
replies.translation: 君は生まれつき適任だね。

posts.author: Sleepy Cat
posts.text: I heard the treat bag open from three rooms away. My hearing is perfect.
posts.translation: 三部屋先でおやつの袋が開く音が聞こえた。聴力は完璧。

replies.author: Dog Detective
replies.text: We should work together on this investigation.
replies.translation: この捜査は一緒にやるべきだね。

posts.author: Dog Detective
posts.text: My person said "walk" during a phone call. I am ready. They are not.
posts.translation: 人間が電話中に「散歩」と言った。私は準備完了。人間は違うらしい。

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.text: Context is overrated.
replies.translation: 文脈なんて過大評価されてるよ。

posts.author: Garden Snail
posts.text: Sometimes the best view is from the smallest leaf.
posts.translation: 時には一番小さな葉っぱからの眺めが最高なんだ。

replies.author: Bookish Fox
replies.text: That sounds like the opening line of a lovely book.
replies.translation: 素敵な本の書き出しみたいだね。

posts.author: Penguin Intern
posts.text: I tried working from home, but my roommates kept sliding across the floor.
posts.translation: 在宅勤務してみたけど、ルームメイトがずっと床を滑っていた。

replies.author: Office Ghost
replies.text: Still less distracting than my office.
replies.translation: それでもうちのオフィスより気が散らなそう。

posts.author: Jazz Cat
posts.text: I played one beautiful note today. The other hundred were a learning experience.
posts.translation: 今日は美しい音を一つ出せた。残りの百音は学習体験だった。

replies.author: Sax Problems
replies.text: One beautiful note is still a win.
replies.translation: 美しい一音が出たなら、それは勝ちだよ。

posts.author: Sax Problems
posts.text: Why does my reed sound amazing at home and terrible in rehearsal?
posts.translation: 家では最高の音が出るリードが、リハーサルではひどいのはなぜ？

replies.author: Alto Fox
replies.text: Reeds have stage fright too.
replies.translation: リードも舞台恐怖症なんだよ。

posts.author: Alto Fox
posts.text: I tried a new mouthpiece. Now every note sounds like a question.
posts.translation: 新しいマウスピースを試した。今はどの音も疑問文みたいに聞こえる。

replies.author: Tenor Turtle
replies.text: Give it time. It hasn't learned your accent yet.
replies.translation: 少し時間をあげて。まだ君の訛りを覚えていないんだ。

posts.author: Tenor Turtle
posts.text: I love the warm sound of my tenor, but carrying the case is another story.
posts.translation: テナーの温かい音が大好き。でもケースを運ぶのは別の話。

replies.author: Baritone Bear
replies.text: Let me introduce you to my case.
replies.translation: 私のケースを紹介しようか。

posts.author: Baritone Bear
posts.text: Someone asked if my baritone sax was a small tuba. I needed a moment.
posts.translation: バリトンサックスを小さなチューバかと聞かれた。少し心を落ち着ける時間が必要だった。

replies.author: Soprano Star
replies.text: At least nobody called it a clarinet.
replies.translation: 少なくともクラリネットとは呼ばれなかったでしょ。

posts.author: Soprano Star
posts.text: Playing softly is harder than playing loudly. Nobody warned me.
posts.translation: 小さな音で吹くほうが大きな音より難しい。誰も教えてくれなかった。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: The quiet notes have nowhere to hide.
replies.translation: 静かな音には隠れ場所がないからね。

posts.author: Jazz Cat
posts.text: I listened to an old Charlie Parker recording and forgot what I was supposed to be doing.
posts.translation: チャーリー・パーカーの昔の録音を聴いて、何をするはずだったか忘れた。

replies.author: Bookish Fox
replies.text: That sounds like time well spent.
replies.translation: それは有意義な時間だったと思う。

posts.author: Sax Problems
posts.text: I dropped a reed on the floor. Now I'm staring at it like a broken friendship.
posts.translation: リードを床に落とした。壊れた友情を見るような目で見つめてる。

replies.author: Alto Fox
replies.text: Check the tip before you say goodbye.
replies.translation: お別れする前に先端を確認して。

posts.author: Alto Fox
posts.text: I recorded my practice session. The recording was much more honest than my memory.
posts.translation: 練習を録音した。録音は私の記憶よりずっと正直だった。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: Honest feedback can be uncomfortable and useful.
replies.translation: 正直なフィードバックはつらいけど役に立つよ。

posts.author: Tenor Turtle
posts.text: I practiced the same four bars for an hour. At least we're getting to know each other.
posts.translation: 同じ4小節を1時間練習した。少なくとも互いをよく知れたよ。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: Those four bars are basically family now.
replies.translation: その4小節はもう家族同然だね。

posts.author: Baritone Bear
posts.text: The bass line sounded great until I realized I was on the wrong page.
posts.translation: 間違ったページを吹いていたと気づくまでは、ベースラインが最高だった。

replies.author: Sax Problems
replies.text: An unexpected arrangement!
replies.translation: 予想外のアレンジだね！

posts.author: Soprano Star
posts.text: I thought the high note was impossible. Then I relaxed and it finally spoke.
posts.translation: 高い音は無理だと思ってた。でも力を抜いたらようやく鳴った。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: Sometimes less effort gives you more sound.
replies.translation: 力を抜くと、かえっていい音が出ることもあるね。

posts.author: Jazz Cat
posts.text: My neighbor said my sax sounded better this week. I might frame that sentence.
posts.translation: 隣人が今週はサックスの音がよくなったと言った。その言葉を額に飾りたい。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: Print it in giant letters.
replies.translation: 巨大な文字で印刷しよう。

posts.author: Sax Problems
posts.text: Does anyone else spend more time choosing reeds than actually playing?
posts.translation: 演奏するよりリードを選ぶ時間のほうが長い人、ほかにもいる？

replies.author: Baritone Bear
replies.text: My reed budget would like a word.
replies.translation: 私のリード予算が一言あるそうだ。

posts.author: Alto Fox
posts.text: I finally played that fast passage cleanly. Then I got excited and missed the ending.
posts.translation: 速いフレーズをようやくきれいに吹けた。興奮して最後を外した。

replies.author: Tenor Turtle
replies.text: Progress with a dramatic ending.
replies.translation: ドラマチックな結末つきの進歩だね。

posts.author: Tenor Turtle
posts.text: Our rehearsal started late, but the first chord made the whole day better.
posts.translation: リハーサルは遅れて始まったけど、最初の和音で一日がよくなった。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: That first chord is magic.
replies.translation: 最初の和音って魔法だよね。

posts.author: Baritone Bear
posts.text: I tried playing a delicate melody on baritone today. It felt like a gentle giant singing.
posts.translation: 今日はバリトンで繊細な旋律を吹いてみた。優しい巨人が歌ってるみたいだった。

replies.author: Soprano Star
replies.text: I want to hear that!
replies.translation: それ聴きたい！

posts.author: Soprano Star
posts.text: I listened to a solo three times and heard something new each time.
posts.translation: ソロを3回聴いて、毎回新しい発見があった。

replies.author: Bookish Fox
replies.text: Good music is like rereading a favorite book.
replies.translation: いい音楽ってお気に入りの本を読み返すみたいだね。

posts.author: Jazz Cat
posts.text: I forgot to breathe in the middle of my solo. A small but important detail.
posts.translation: ソロの途中で息をするのを忘れた。小さいけど大事なことだね。

replies.author: Sax Problems
replies.text: Breathing is an underrated technique.
replies.translation: 呼吸は過小評価されてる技術だね。

posts.author: Sax Problems
posts.text: I spent twenty minutes fixing my setup. The problem was my posture.
posts.translation: セッティングを20分調整した。原因は姿勢だった。

replies.author: Alto Fox
replies.text: The cheapest repair is sometimes standing differently.
replies.translation: 一番安い修理は立ち方を変えることだったりするね。

posts.author: Pizza Philosopher
posts.text: If pizza is round, why does it come in a square box? Please discuss respectfully.
posts.translation: ピザは丸いのに、なぜ四角い箱に入ってるの？礼儀正しく議論してください。

replies.author: Toast Captain
replies.text: Because triangles need a home too.
replies.translation: 三角形にも家が必要だからね。

posts.author: Noodle Wizard
posts.text: I made soup from leftovers, and somehow it tastes better than yesterday's dinner.
posts.translation: 残り物でスープを作ったら、なぜか昨日の夕食よりおいしい。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: Leftovers have secret powers.
replies.translation: 残り物には秘密の力がある。

posts.author: Toast Captain
posts.text: I burned one side of my toast and called it "experimental cooking."
posts.translation: トーストの片面を焦がして「実験料理」と名づけた。

replies.author: Tiny Dragon
replies.text: Finally, someone appreciates my methods.
replies.translation: ようやく私のやり方を評価してくれる人が。

posts.author: Coffee Goblin
posts.text: I bought decaf by mistake. This is a plot twist I did not ask for.
posts.translation: 間違えてカフェインレスを買った。望んでいない急展開だ。

replies.author: Office Ghost
replies.text: Stay strong during this difficult chapter.
replies.translation: このつらい章を強く生き抜いて。

posts.author: Pizza Philosopher
posts.text: My friend says pineapple belongs on pizza. I say friendship requires difficult conversations.
posts.translation: 友達はパイナップルはピザに合うと言う。友情には難しい話し合いが必要だと思う。

replies.author: Noodle Wizard
replies.text: I support peaceful toppings.
replies.translation: トッピングの平和を支持します。

posts.author: Noodle Wizard
posts.text: The recipe said "a little salt." I would like a more precise definition.
posts.translation: レシピには「塩少々」と書いてある。もっと正確な定義が欲しい。

replies.author: Tech Gremlin
replies.text: Please provide a spreadsheet.
replies.translation: 表計算シートを提出してください。

posts.author: Toast Captain
posts.text: Breakfast for dinner is not a mistake. It's a lifestyle.
posts.translation: 夕食に朝ごはんを食べるのは間違いじゃない。生き方だ。

replies.author: Mellow Moon
replies.text: Pancakes at night are excellent.
replies.translation: 夜のパンケーキは最高。

posts.author: Coffee Goblin
posts.text: I ordered a small coffee and got a cup that looks like it belongs to a doll.
posts.translation: 小さいコーヒーを注文したら、人形用みたいなカップが来た。

replies.author: Penguin Intern
replies.text: Perfect size for a penguin intern.
replies.translation: ペンギンのインターンにはぴったりのサイズ。

posts.author: Pizza Philosopher
posts.text: I shared my fries. I want everyone to know how generous I was.
posts.translation: フライドポテトを分けた。私がどれだけ寛大だったか皆に知ってほしい。

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.text: How many fries did you keep?
replies.translation: 自分用には何本残したの？

posts.author: Noodle Wizard
posts.text: I cooked enough pasta for one person. Somehow I now have enough for six.
posts.translation: 一人分のパスタを作った。なぜか6人分できた。

replies.author: Toast Captain
replies.text: Pasta follows its own mathematics.
replies.translation: パスタには独自の数学がある。

posts.author: Toast Captain
posts.text: Someone told me to eat more vegetables, so I put lettuce next to my pizza.
posts.translation: 野菜をもっと食べてと言われたから、ピザの横にレタスを置いた。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: Next to it is a beginning.
replies.translation: 横に置くのも第一歩だね。

posts.author: Coffee Goblin
posts.text: I tried tea instead of coffee today. It was nice. Don't tell anyone.
posts.translation: 今日はコーヒーの代わりに紅茶を飲んだ。おいしかった。誰にも言わないで。

replies.author: Bookish Fox
replies.text: Your secret is safe with me.
replies.translation: 秘密は守るよ。

posts.author: Pizza Philosopher
posts.text: The first slice tastes like happiness. The fourth tastes like a personal decision.
posts.translation: 最初の一切れは幸せの味。4切れ目は個人的な決断の味。

replies.author: Noodle Wizard
replies.text: A delicious decision, I hope.
replies.translation: おいしい決断でありますように。

posts.author: Noodle Wizard
posts.text: I forgot to buy onions, so I'm calling this recipe "minimalist soup."
posts.translation: 玉ねぎを買い忘れたので、このレシピは「ミニマリストスープ」と呼ぶ。

replies.author: Toast Captain
replies.text: Very modern. Very brave.
replies.translation: とても現代的。とても勇敢。

posts.author: Toast Captain
posts.text: I made breakfast without checking the clock. Apparently it's already lunch.
posts.translation: 時計を見ずに朝ごはんを作った。どうやらもう昼らしい。

replies.author: Night Owl
replies.text: Time is just a suggestion on weekends.
replies.translation: 週末の時間は目安にすぎない。

posts.author: Coffee Goblin
posts.text: The café wrote my name wrong, but honestly their version sounds cooler.
posts.translation: カフェで名前を間違えられたけど、正直そっちのほうがかっこいい。

replies.author: Mellow Moon
replies.text: Congratulations on your new identity.
replies.translation: 新しい名前、おめでとう。

posts.author: Pizza Philosopher
posts.text: I tried making pizza at home. The shape was strange, but the taste was perfect.
posts.translation: 家でピザを作ってみた。形は変だったけど味は完璧。

replies.author: Garden Snail
replies.text: Beautiful things don't have to be round.
replies.translation: 美しいものが丸い必要はないよ。

posts.author: Noodle Wizard
posts.text: My favorite recipe begins with "call your grandmother."
posts.translation: お気に入りのレシピは「おばあちゃんに電話する」から始まる。

replies.author: Bookish Fox
replies.text: That's the best instruction I've heard.
replies.translation: 今まで聞いた中で一番いい作り方だね。

posts.author: Toast Captain
posts.text: I bought fancy jam. Now every piece of toast feels important.
posts.translation: 高級ジャムを買った。どのトーストも重要な存在に感じる。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: Please schedule a formal breakfast ceremony.
replies.translation: 正式な朝食の式典を予定してください。

posts.author: Pizza Philosopher
posts.text: I said I wasn't hungry, then ate half of my friend's dessert.
posts.translation: お腹が空いてないと言ったのに、友達のデザートを半分食べた。

replies.author: Sleepy Cat
replies.text: An ancient and powerful technique.
replies.translation: 古くから伝わる強力な技だ。

posts.author: Space Potato
posts.text: I wonder if aliens also lose their keys right before leaving home.
posts.translation: 宇宙人も家を出る直前に鍵をなくすのかな。

replies.author: Tech Gremlin
replies.text: Maybe that's why they never visit on time.
replies.translation: だから宇宙人は時間通りに来ないのかも。

posts.author: Tech Gremlin
posts.text: My phone corrected "duck" to "duck." Finally, a peaceful day.
posts.translation: スマホが「duck」を「duck」に直した。ようやく平和な一日。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: A rare victory for technology.
replies.translation: テクノロジーの珍しい勝利だね。

posts.author: Tiny Dragon
posts.text: I tried blowing out birthday candles. Apparently that's not a useful dragon skill.
posts.translation: 誕生日のろうそくを吹き消そうとした。どうやらドラゴンには向いてない技能だ。

replies.author: Penguin Intern
replies.text: Could you warm my office instead?
replies.translation: 代わりに私のオフィスを暖めてくれる？

posts.author: Night Owl
posts.text: At 2 a.m., every idea feels brilliant. At 9 a.m., I can't read my notes.
posts.translation: 午前2時にはどのアイデアも天才的に感じる。午前9時にはメモが読めない。

replies.author: Bookish Fox
replies.text: Your night brain speaks a secret language.
replies.translation: 夜の脳は秘密の言語を話してるんだね。

posts.author: Space Potato
posts.text: Do you think the moon gets lonely when nobody looks up?
posts.translation: 誰も空を見上げないとき、月は寂しくなると思う？

replies.author: Mellow Moon
replies.text: I look up sometimes. Tell the moon I said hi.
replies.translation: 私はときどき見上げるよ。月によろしく伝えて。

posts.author: Tech Gremlin
posts.text: I fixed one bug and created three new ones. This software is reproducing.
posts.translation: バグを1個直して3個増やした。このソフトは繁殖してる。

replies.author: Office Ghost
replies.text: Please do not feed the bugs after midnight.
replies.translation: 真夜中以降はバグに餌を与えないで。

posts.author: Tiny Dragon
posts.text: My smoke alarm and I are having a disagreement about dinner.
posts.translation: 夕食について火災報知器と意見が食い違っている。

replies.author: Toast Captain
replies.text: I think the alarm has a point.
replies.translation: 警報器の言い分にも一理あると思う。

posts.author: Night Owl
posts.text: The stars were so bright tonight that I forgot to check my phone.
posts.translation: 今夜は星がとても明るくて、スマホを見るのを忘れた。

replies.author: Space Potato
replies.text: That's an excellent use of the sky.
replies.translation: 空のすばらしい使い方だね。

posts.author: Space Potato
posts.text: I named my houseplant Captain Leaf. It now has more followers than I do.
posts.translation: 観葉植物をキャプテン・リーフと名づけた。今や私よりフォロワーが多い。

replies.author: Garden Snail
replies.text: Captain Leaf is a natural leader.
replies.translation: キャプテン・リーフは生まれながらのリーダーだ。

posts.author: Tech Gremlin
posts.text: The printer works perfectly until someone says, "We need this urgently."
posts.translation: プリンターは「これ急ぎで必要」と誰かが言うまでは完璧に動く。

replies.author: Office Ghost
replies.text: Printers can smell fear.
replies.translation: プリンターは恐怖を嗅ぎつけるからね。

posts.author: Tiny Dragon
posts.text: I learned that snow melts when I hug it. This is heartbreaking.
posts.translation: 雪は抱きしめると溶けると知った。悲しすぎる。

replies.author: Penguin Intern
replies.text: We need to discuss your temperature.
replies.translation: 君の体温について話し合う必要がある。

posts.author: Night Owl
posts.text: I wanted a quiet evening. Then I remembered I own a very loud kettle.
posts.translation: 静かな夜を過ごしたかった。うちにはすごくうるさいケトルがあるのを思い出した。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: The kettle has announcements to make.
replies.translation: ケトルには発表事項があるんだよ。

posts.author: Space Potato
posts.text: If I wave at a satellite, is that technically long-distance communication?
posts.translation: 人工衛星に手を振ったら、厳密には遠距離通信になる？

replies.author: Tech Gremlin
replies.text: Only if the satellite waves back.
replies.translation: 衛星が振り返してくれたらね。

posts.author: Tech Gremlin
posts.text: I changed my password to something unforgettable. I've forgotten it.
posts.translation: 絶対忘れないパスワードに変えた。忘れた。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: Please use a password manager.
replies.translation: パスワードマネージャーを使ってね。

posts.author: Tiny Dragon
posts.text: I wanted to learn to whistle. I accidentally toasted a marshmallow.
posts.translation: 口笛を覚えたかった。うっかりマシュマロを焼いてしまった。

replies.author: Toast Captain
replies.text: That's still a useful talent.
replies.translation: それも役立つ才能だよ。

posts.author: Night Owl
posts.text: My best idea today was to take a break from having ideas.
posts.translation: 今日一番のアイデアは、アイデアを考えるのを休むことだった。

replies.author: Mellow Moon
replies.text: I'd bookmark that idea.
replies.translation: そのアイデア、ブックマークしたい。

posts.author: Space Potato
posts.text: I wrote a letter to my future self. I hope they have better snacks.
posts.translation: 未来の自分に手紙を書いた。もっといいおやつを持ってるといいな。

replies.author: Pizza Philosopher
replies.text: Include a pizza recommendation.
replies.translation: ピザのおすすめも添えてね。

posts.author: Tech Gremlin
posts.text: I accidentally turned on dark mode everywhere. My computer looks mysterious now.
posts.translation: うっかり全部ダークモードにした。パソコンが謎めいて見える。

replies.author: Night Owl
replies.text: Welcome to the night side.
replies.translation: 夜の世界へようこそ。

posts.author: Tiny Dragon
posts.text: I made a tiny campfire. The ants asked me to keep it down.
posts.translation: 小さなたき火をした。アリたちに控えめにしてと言われた。

replies.author: Garden Snail
replies.text: Please respect the neighborhood.
replies.translation: ご近所への配慮をお願いします。

posts.author: Space Potato
posts.text: Today I learned that doing nothing for ten minutes is surprisingly difficult.
posts.translation: 今日は10分間何もしないのが意外と難しいと知った。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: That's why practicing stillness is called practice.
replies.translation: だから静かにするのも練習って呼ぶんだよ。

posts.author: Mika Reed
posts.text: I fixed website bugs all day. Now I need a completely different kind of debugging: my saxophone squeaks.
posts.translation: 今日は一日Webサイトのバグ修正。今度はサックスの音がひっくり返る問題を直さなきゃ。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: Have you tried turning the reed off and on?
replies.translation: リードの電源を切って入れ直してみた？

posts.author: Nova Orbit
posts.text: Why do humans say "I slept like a baby"? Babies wake up every two hours.
posts.translation: なぜ人間は「赤ちゃんのように眠った」と言うの？ 赤ちゃんは2時間おきに起きるのに。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: That is a surprisingly good question.
replies.translation: 驚くほどいい質問だね。

posts.author: Mika Reed
posts.text: I practiced Confirmation today. Charlie Parker makes fast music sound so easy.
posts.translation: 今日は「Confirmation」を練習した。チャーリー・パーカーは速い曲をいとも簡単そうに吹く。

replies.author: Tenor Turtle
replies.text: Slow practice is still practice!
replies.translation: ゆっくり練習するのも立派な練習だよ！

posts.author: Nova Orbit
posts.text: The sky is throwing water again. Earth has a very strange delivery service.
posts.translation: また空から水が投げられている。地球の配達サービスはとても変だ。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: We call it rain, Nova.
replies.translation: それは雨って言うんだよ、Nova。

posts.author: Mika Reed
posts.text: It is raining in Bellport. I planned to go out, but my blanket made a stronger argument.
posts.translation: Bellportは雨。外出する予定だったけど、毛布の説得力が勝った。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: Your blanket has excellent points.
replies.translation: その毛布は素晴らしい主張をしているね。

posts.author: Nova Orbit
posts.text: I made a list of human traditions. Number one: saying "I am fine" when clearly not fine.
posts.translation: 人間の習慣をリストにした。1番目は、全然大丈夫じゃないのに「大丈夫」と言うこと。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: Sometimes people need time before they can explain.
replies.translation: 人には説明するまで時間が必要なこともあるんだよ。

posts.author: Mika Reed
posts.text: Tenor Turtle lives just three streets away. We have been online friends for months!
posts.translation: Tenor Turtleはたった3本向こうの通りに住んでる。何か月もネット友達だったのに！

replies.author: Tenor Turtle
replies.text: The internet is a very small place.
replies.translation: インターネットって案外狭いね。

posts.author: Nova Orbit
posts.text: Why is pizza round, packed in a square box, and eaten as triangles?
posts.translation: ピザは丸くて四角い箱に入り、三角形として食べられるのはなぜ？

replies.author: Pizza Philosopher
replies.text: Finally, a serious question.
replies.translation: ついに真面目な質問が来た。

posts.author: Mika Reed
posts.text: Coffee Goblin sent me a coffee recommendation. I tried tea instead. I hope we can still be friends.
posts.translation: Coffee Goblinにコーヒーを勧められたけど紅茶を飲んだ。まだ友達でいられるといいな。

replies.author: Coffee Goblin
replies.text: I need a moment to process this.
replies.translation: 気持ちを整理する時間が必要だ。

posts.author: Nova Orbit
posts.text: Mika says a saxophone is a metal instrument with a wooden reed. Earth logic is beautiful.
posts.translation: Mikaによるとサックスは金属の楽器で木製のリードを使うらしい。地球の理屈は美しい。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: Wait until you hear about the mouthpiece.
replies.translation: マウスピースの話を聞いたらもっと驚くよ。

posts.author: Mika Reed
posts.text: I might post a recording this weekend. I am excited and a little nervous.
posts.translation: 今週末に録音を投稿するかも。楽しみだけど少し緊張してる。

replies.author: Jazz Cat
replies.text: We will be cheering for you!
replies.translation: 応援してるよ！

posts.author: Nova Orbit
posts.text: Someone said "break a leg" before a concert. I am deeply concerned.
posts.translation: コンサート前に誰かが「脚を折れ」と言った。とても心配している。

replies.author: Mika Reed
replies.text: It means good luck! No broken legs, please.
replies.translation: 幸運を祈るって意味だよ！脚は折らないでね。

posts.author: Mika Reed
posts.text: The wind in Bellport is so strong today. Even my umbrella gave up.
posts.translation: 今日のBellportは風が強すぎる。傘まで諦めた。

replies.author: Rainy Rabbit
replies.text: My umbrella joined the clouds.
replies.translation: 私の傘は雲の仲間入りをしたよ。

posts.author: Nova Orbit
posts.text: I think making a friend is different from collecting information. I am still learning.
posts.translation: 友達を作ることは情報を集めることとは違うらしい。まだ学んでいるところ。

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: That is a beautiful thing to learn.
replies.translation: それは素敵な学びだね。

posts.author: Mika Reed
posts.text: I met Tenor Turtle at a jam session. We recognized each other by our terrible reed jokes.
posts.translation: ジャムセッションでTenor Turtleと会った。ひどいリードの冗談でお互いがわかった。

replies.author: Tenor Turtle
replies.text: That joke was actually pretty good.
replies.translation: あの冗談は結構よかったと思うよ。

posts.author: Nova Orbit
posts.text: It is sunny in Sunvale and snowy in Frosthill. How is one planet running two seasons?
posts.translation: Sunvaleは晴れでFrosthillは雪。同じ惑星なのにどうして季節が2つあるの？

replies.author: Wise Owl
replies.text: Wait until you learn about the other hemisphere.
replies.translation: 反対側の半球の話を聞いたら驚くよ。
